title: A coarse block-cut tree theorem
summary: We prove a coarse analogue of the classic fact that every graph can be decomposed along its cut-vertices into $2$-connected components. Precisely, we prove that for every graph $G$ and a positive integer $d$, $G$ admits a tree decomposition whose adhesion sets have weak diameter at most $3d+2$ so that no two vertices $u,v$ lying in the same bag can be separated by a set of weak diameter at most $d$ whose distance from $u$ and $v$ is more than $d$.
